dedupe_keys.name: projections of climate hydrology and energy production for the drammen river basin

description: The STARS4Water team deposits climate, hydrology and energy-production projections for Norway's Drammen river basin. Its public README ties the release to selected COR-BA-2025 downscaled climate projections and names precipitation, temperature, snow water equivalent, runoff and hydropower production as outputs. Zenodo lists separate Climate, HBV, LISFLOOD, EOPS and GIS ZIP packages under CC BY 4.0. These scenario results can provide boundary conditions or comparison series for a basin-reservoir or hydropower simulation. The source ensemble covers Norway, but this deposit focuses on Drammen; a national spatial tag would overstate its coverage. The largest LISFLOOD package is about 509 MB and was not opened. Exact series units, temporal alignment and dam operating assumptions remain unverified. The related general catalogue does not identify this specific Drammen release, so its five packages are treated as one deposit, not five independent records.
name: Projections of climate, hydrology and energy production for the Drammen river basin
